content.stem: 金融情报机构(FIU)通过以下方式帮助维护金融诚信:(选择两项.)

options.A: 接收并分析可疑活动报告(SAR),以侦测金融犯罪
options.B: 传播有关洗钱及相关上游犯罪新趋势的信息
options.C: 协助金融机构设计降低剩余洗钱风险的产品和服务
options.D: 确保金融机构维持与其风险状况相适应的适当反洗钱计划

content.stem_en: Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) help to protect financial integrity by: (Select two.)

options_en.A: Receiving and analyzing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) to detect financial crime
options_en.B: Disseminating information on emerging trends related to money laundering and associated predicate offenses
options_en.C: Assisting financial institutions with designing products and services that lower residual money laundering risk
options_en.D: Ensuring financial institutions maintain appropriate AML programs commensurate with their risk profiles
